messages:
Eli: Quick sync on Halcyon POC timeline — target staging cutover 2026-04-07, dry-run 2026-04-09, prod window 2026-04-14 to 2026-04-16. Can eng owners confirm infra/networking/SSO readiness? cc @Anjali @Josh
Anjali: I can own infra + networking. Quick question: do they want VPC peering or just IP allowlist? also who owns cert rotation for SAML?
Josh: They need VPC peering (private). Also requested SAML SSO via Okta. Milestones from SE: staging cutover 4/7, dry-run 4/9. Can Platform ensure routes/firewall rules by 4/5?
Anjali: Peering ok. Need subnet ranges, ASN, and any required NAT/egress IPs. If we get those today I can aim for peering by 4/3. I'll create a tracker in eng-platform board.
Eli: Subnets: 10.240.0.0/16. Egress IPs: 35.198.12.0/24. ASN: 64512. SAML metadata: https://okta.halcyon.com/metadata.xml
Josh: Added details to the shared POC doc -> https://redwood.app/drive/halcyon-poc (edit: ensure you have access)
Marco: Heads-up from runtime side: model pinning for the trial needs the quantized fp16 variant. We'll need a model build staged by 2026-04-01. @Priya can you run quantization and smoke tests?
Priya: I can take the quantization job. Need a sample prompt set (~50 prompts) and a small eval harness. Josh — can you attach the prompt set we use for regressions?
Josh: Prompt set uploaded to the doc above + added a CSV in the repo under integrations/halcyon/prompts.csv
Devbot: deploy Halcyon-staging: model-build-20260330 queued — status: pending
Samira: For cutover we need a 2hr maintenance window on 2026-04-14 01:00-03:00 UTC (for DNS & final routing). Also request monitoring dashboards and SLO alerts provisioned before dry-run.
Anjali: We'll align autoscaling policies and set alerts. Can someone confirm the SLOs in the contract?
Eli: Contract excerpt: 99.9% uptime; p95 latency for embeddings < 300ms. Logging retention 90 days.
Priya: Note: embeddings workload can spike token usage. Recommend batching config: max_batch_tokens=4096 and prefix/KV caching enabled. I'll add a recommendation to Redwood Optimize.
Josh: Code review ping: PR #2745 (integrations/halcyon — SSO/env toggles) needs review/approval. @Eli can you sanity-check the secrets flow for prod?
Eli: I'll review PR #2745 tonight and flag any issues.
Anjali: Creating peering ticket ENG-4821 and tagging owners. ETA for peering work: 2026-04-03 assuming we get subnet/ASN info today.
Josh: Consolidated outstanding deps: VPC peering (Anjali), SAML cert ingest (Security), model build & quantization (Priya), prompt set (Josh), DR window & monitoring (Samira), PR review (Eli). Anything else?
Neal: Security will own SAML cert ingest and review. Please send metadata and SP config to security@redwood.com. We’ll target review complete by 2026-04-02.
Eli: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate this into the canonical POC timeline doc and ping updates. If anything slips on owners/dates, flag here and we'll re-prioritize.
